title: Unit – 1 : Session – 3 : SLO – 2 | Apply Control Structures
sections: 1) Prime check for n = 7: loop i = 2..3, 7 % 2 = 1 and 7 % 3 = 1, so flag stays 0 → Output: Prime. Uses selection inside iteration.
2) Factorial: fact = 1; for i = 1..n, fact *= i → for n = 5: 1×2×3×4×5 = 120. Uses iteration (sequence of multiplications).
3) Largest of a, b, c: if (a > b && a > c) print a; else if (b > c) print b; else print c → for a=3, b=9, c=5 → Output: 9. Uses nested selection (if-else ladder).
